findings.evidence: Coxeter.lean:154-161 vs 193-200 (identical text); 165-179 vs 218-230 (identical apart from `.reverse`). `map_list_prod` and `LinearEquiv.automorphismGroup.toLinearMapMonoidHom` are Mathlib (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Basic.lean:114), so the shared step is a two-line private lemma.
findings.fix: Factor both out as private lemmas above the two theorems: `private theorem map_toLinearMap_attach {l} (hl) : l.attach.map (fun i : {i // i ∈ l} ↦ (vertexReflection Q (hl i.1 i.2)).toLinearMap) = l.map (vertexPreReflection Q)` (the current `hlist` proof verbatim), and `private theorem toLinearMap_list_prod (L : List ((Q → ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Q → ℤ))) : (L.prod).toLinearMap = (L.map LinearEquiv.toLinearMap).prod` from `map_list_prod LinearEquiv.automorphismGroup.toLinearMapMonoidHom L` plus `LinearEquiv.automorphismGroup.toLinearMapMonoidHom_apply`. Both theorems then reduce to `rw [toLinearMap_list_prod, List.map_reverse, map_toLinearMap_attach]`-style one-liners, and the only content unique to the `symm` version stays the `hinv` step.
findings.issue: `coe_vertexReflectionProd` and `coe_vertexReflectionProd_symm` repeat the same proof twice: the `hlist` block at lines 154-161 is byte-identical to lines 193-200, and the `map_list_prod` calc step at 165-179 is identical to 218-230 up to the presence of `.reverse`.

findings.evidence: The dependency file states every such result only in pre-reflection form — `titsForm_vertexPreReflection` (DimensionVector.lean:150), `titsPolarForm_vertexPreReflection` (161), `bijOn_vertexPreReflection` (172) — with no `vertexReflection` mirror; `coe_vertexReflection` (135) is the `@[simp]` bridge, and `bijOn_vertexPreReflection`'s own proof (180) uses it that way.

findings.issue: `vertexReflectionProd_eq_self_iff` (305) and `vertexReflectionProd_eq_self_iff_of_anisotropic` (327) add no content over `vertexPreReflectionProd_eq_self_iff` (296) and `vertexPreReflectionProd_eq_self_iff_of_anisotropic` (317): each proof is `simp only [coe_vertexReflectionProd]; exact <pre version>`, i.e. the statements coincide under the `@[simp]` lemma `coe_vertexReflectionProd` (151).

summary: The mathematics is new — no Coxeter transformation on dimension vectors exists in TauCeti or Mathlib, and the inductions reuse the single-vertex lemmas of DimensionVector.lean correctly. Two duplications remain: a verbatim-repeated proof block across the two coercion lemmas, and a pair of automorphism-packaged theorems that restate their pre-reflection counterparts modulo an existing @[simp] lemma.
